movie.title: Peak Everything
movie.overview: Adam is a kind-hearted kennel-owner. Hypersensitive and borderline depressed, Adam orders a therapeutic solar lamp. Through the lamp’s supplier's technical support line, he meets Tina, a radiant woman with a voice that soothes all of his worries. This unexpected encounter changes everything: Earth trembles, and hearts explode… It's love!

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a sensitive kennel owner orders a therapeutic solar lamp, an unexpected phone call with a tech support agent sparks a transformative love story.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Adam, a kind-hearted but deeply sensitive kennel owner struggling with low spirits, decides to purchase a therapeutic solar lamp to help cope with his gloom. His life takes a dramatic turn when he contacts technical support and connects with Tina, whose warm and soothing voice instantly captures his heart. What begins as a routine customer service call quickly blossoms into a sudden, earth-shattering romance that upends both of their worlds.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Adam spends his days caring for dogs as a kind-hearted kennel owner, but behind his gentle demeanor lies a hypersensitive and borderline depressed man looking for relief. In an effort to brighten his dark mood and find emotional stability, he orders a specialized therapeutic solar lamp. When issues arise with the device, Adam reaches out to the product's technical support line, expecting a routine customer service interaction. Instead, he is connected with Tina, a vibrant and radiant representative whose calming voice immediately alleviates his anxieties. As their conversation unfolds, a profound and instantaneous connection forms between the two strangers. Their unexpected chemistry transforms a simple technical query into a life-altering emotional explosion that leaves Adam feeling truly seen for the first time. The intensity of their newfound love shakes the very foundation of Adam's quiet existence, replacing his chronic gloom with radiant hope. Together, their chance encounter sets off a romantic chain reaction that proves love can shine through even the darkest circumstances.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Struggling with hypersensitivity and persistent melancholia, gentle kennel owner Adam turns to light therapy in hopes of easing his emotional burdens. However, the real cure comes not from the lamp itself, but from Tina—the radiant tech support representative on the other end of the helpline. Her soothing voice and magnetic personality instantly cut through Adam's inner darkness, sparking an intense and sudden romantic connection. Peak Everything is a heartwarming blend of comedy and drama that explores how a simple, unexpected human connection can dramatically illuminate a person's life.

story_structure.climax: Their growing bond leads to a powerful emotional turning point where their feelings explode into an overwhelming, life-altering realization of love.
story_structure.conflict: Seeking relief from his blues, Adam orders a therapeutic solar lamp and ends up calling customer service, where he unexpectedly connects with a warm-voiced woman named Tina.
story_structure.resolution: Transformed by the connection, Adam emerges from his emotional darkness with a renewed sense of warmth, joy, and hope for the future.
story_structure.introduction: Adam, a sensitive and mild-mannered kennel owner struggling with low spirits, leads a quiet and isolated life dedicated to his dogs.
story_structure.risingAction: Through their phone conversations, Adam and Tina develop a deep emotional spark that brightens his world, forcing him to step out of his comfort zone and confront his emotional vulnerabilities.
